classification.difficultyReason: Decode a complete dataset, compute both measures, then filter boundary observations and recompute with the changed count and median parity.

content.prompt: The chest measurement in centimetres of 23 people is taken. The results are recorded in the stem-and-leaf plot shown.

spec.description: Four stems and the complete printed leaves, with a single vertical divider and no printed key.
spec.mathematics: 8: 8,9; 9: 3,3,3,4,5,6,7,9,9; 10: 0,1,2,3,4,6,6,7,7; 11: 1,1,9. Stem and leaf denote tens and units in centimetres.
spec.answerVisibility: All plotted observations are permanent question givens; no answers are shown.

answer.worked:
There are 23 observations, so the median is the 12th observation in ascending order. The first two stems contain $2+9=11$ observations, so the 12th observation is 100.

$$\text{Median}=100\text{ cm}.$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the mean, correct to two decimal places.

answer.worked:
The sums for stems 8, 9, 10 and 11 are 177, 859, 936 and 341 respectively.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Mean}&=\frac{177+859+936+341}{23}\\\text{Mean}&=\frac{2313}{23}\text{ cm}\\\text{Mean}&\approx100.57\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the mean and median if the readings less than 90 and greater than 110 are not included. Give the mean correct to two decimal places.

answer.worked:
Exclude 88, 89, 111, 111 and 119. There are $23-5=18$ observations remaining, with sum $859+936=1795$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Mean}&=\frac{1795}{18}\text{ cm}\\\text{Mean}&\approx99.72\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$

The 9th and 10th remaining observations are 99 and 100.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Median}&=\frac{99+100}{2}\text{ cm}\\\text{Median}&=99.5\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$
